correctness.rationale: The quartic is exactly the one in Veniani Example 5.4. An independent finite-field implementation enumerated all 9^4+9^3+2·9^2+9+1=7462 RREF 2-subspaces of F9^4, tested all five coefficients of the quartic restriction and obtained exactly 48 distinct F9 lines; pivot charts contain 33,11,0,2,1,1 candidates. Veniani independently establishes there are exactly 48 *geometric* lines, so the F9 list exhausts algebraic closure. Frobenius (x→x^3) partitions these 48 as 6 fixed +21 pairs. On each RREF Grassmannian chart, independent dual-number differentiation of all five restricted quartic equations gives tangent dimension 1 at exactly seven supports (one fixed + three pairs) and 0 at 41. Since geometric support is finite, tangent≠0 implies nonreduced local Artin ring, whereas tangent0 implies residue field by Nakayama; reduced part is finite étale over perfect F3. This yields N_n=6 (odd),48 (even) and zeta (1-T)^(-6)(1-T^2)^(-21). The local *lengths* of the seven thickened points are not determined.
